summary: Commercial satellite manufacturer CesiumAstro secured $730 million in a Series D funding round led by Janus Henderson at a valuation exceeding $4.5 billion, while unveiling its Synchronicity satellite constellation following its successful Element-1 mission. In launch developments, Blue Origin announced a new engine and a third stage for its heavy-lift New Glenn rocket. In civil spaceflight, astronauts aboard the International Space Station completed a spacewalk to finish installing next-generation solar arrays. NASA shared plans to accelerate its Artemis program to return humans to the Moon, alongside China's ongoing preparations to land astronauts on the lunar surface before 2030. NASA also unveiled its experimental X-70 Fractal aircraft for flight research and confirmed that the interstellar Voyager 1 probe recovered from a communications glitch, though the agency's Swift space telescope burned up in Earth's atmosphere following a failed robotic rescue attempt. In military space and defense developments, the Department of the Air Force released an enterprise blueprint to field operational system integration across 15 mission domains, the Pentagon issued a $150 million loan to LeoLabs to construct ground radars, and Ukraine announced it is seeking a new SpaceX Starshield agreement by mid-2027. In scientific discoveries, European orbiter data revealed fresh hints of volcanic activity on Mars, while astronomers delivered the sharpest low-frequency radio survey of the sky to date. Looking ahead, industry observers should watch for initial results from upcoming field tests of Shield AI's newly constructed X-BAT drone prototype.
